title: Vera's two outbound email shells went out with no postal address, after LIVE-728 put it on every other commercial footer
detail:
FOUND 2026-10-05 in the scan-six read of LIVE-728 (56718d8, ADR-1663). lib/ai/vera/execute.ts outboundEmailHtml (a human-approved outreach or intro to a CRM contact) and lib/ai/vera/autonomous-send.ts autonomousEmailHtml (an autonomous lifecycle email to a member) build their own footer with an unsubscribe link, a lifecycle token and List-Unsubscribe headers, and neither printed PLATFORM_POSTAL_LINE. CAN-SPAM asks for a physical address on every commercial message.

CLOSED 2026-10-05: both shells append postalFooterHtml() after the unsubscribe line and the plain-text parts end with PLATFORM_POSTAL_LINE; lib/email-studio/postal.test.ts reads both sources beside the three it already read.

verify.note: Reads both Vera shells for the HTML and text postal line.

source.ref: found 2026-10-05 by the scan-six adversarial read of the 2026-09-28..30 merges
